evidence.reason: At the cited lines, an unresolved selection causes every unselected script to be pushed onto worklist. Because worklist is not deduplicated against already-queued names, repeated unresolved selections enqueue the same scripts many times, producing quadratic queue growth and possible heap exhaustion for a package with many scripts. Returning all script names immediately on the first unresolved selection preserves the existing conservative result (an unresolved selection already causes all scripts to be selected) while avoiding the duplicate queue buildup. This is a routine correctness/resource-safety repair, not a new requirement.
